description_zh: 调用DescribeCenRouteMaps接口查询路由策略中已配置信息
name: DescribeCenRouteMaps

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the route map is applied.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: cen_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The direction in which the route map is applied. Valid values:

RegionIn: Routes are advertised to the regional gateway of the CEN instance.

 For example, routes are advertised from a network instance in the local region to the local regional gateway, or routes are advertised from a regional gateway in another region to the local regional gateway.

RegionOut: Routes are advertised from the regional gateway of the CEN instance.

 For example, routes are advertised from the local regional gateway to network instances in the local region, or routes are advertised from the local regional gateway to regional gateways in other regions
parameters.help_zh:
路由策略的应用方向。取值：

RegionIn：入地域网关方向，表示路由传入云企业网地域网关的方向。

 例如：路由从本地域的网络实例发布到本地域网关，或其他地域的路由发布到本地域网关。

RegionOut：出地域网关方向，表示路由传出云企业网地域网关的方向。

 例如：路由从本地域网关发布到本地域下的网络实例，或发布到其他地域的地域网关
parameters.name: transmit_direction

RouteMap.description_en: The list of route map information

AsPathMatchMode.description_en:
The match mode of the AS path list. Valid values:

Include: fuzzy match. A route matches the condition if the AS path of the route overlaps with the AS path specified in the match condition. 

Complete: exact match. A route matches the condition only if the AS path of the route is the same as the AS path specified in the match condition
AsPathMatchMode.description_zh:
AS Path列表的匹配模式。

Include：模糊匹配，匹配条件中的AS Path与被匹配路由的AS Path有重叠即判定为匹配成功。 

Complete：精确匹配，匹配条件中的AS Path必须与被匹配路由的AS Path一致，才判定为匹配成功。

CenId.description_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance

CenRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the route map is applied

CidrMatchMode.description_en:
The match mode of the prefix list. Valid values:

Include: fuzzy match. A route matches the condition if the route prefix in the match condition contains the route prefix of the route to be matched.

 For example, if you set the match condition to 10.10.0.0/16, the route whose prefix is 10.10.1.0/24 matches the condition.

Complete: exact match. A route matches the condition only if the route prefix in the match condition is the same as the route prefix of the route to be matched. 

 For example, if you set the match condition to 10.10.0.0/16, only the route whose prefix is 10.10.0.0/16 matches the condition
CidrMatchMode.description_zh:
前缀列表的匹配模式。取值：

Include：模糊匹配。匹配条件中的路由前缀包含被匹配路由的路由前缀即判定为匹配成功。

 例如：定义10.10.0.0/16的策略可以模糊匹配到10.10.1.0/24的路由。

Complete：精确匹配。匹配条件中的路由前缀必须与被匹配路由的路由前缀一致，才判定为匹配成功。 

 例如：定义10.10.0.0/16的策略仅可以精确匹配到10.10.0.0/16的路由

CommunityMatchMode.description_en:
The match mode of the Community attribute. Valid values:

Include: fuzzy match. A route matches the condition if the Community attribute of the route overlaps with the Community attribute specified in the match condition. 

Complete: exact match. A route matches the condition only if the Community attribute of the route is the same as the Community attribute specified in the match condition
CommunityMatchMode.description_zh:
Community的匹配模式。

Include：模糊匹配，匹配条件中的Community与被匹配路由的Community有重叠即判定为匹配成功。 

Complete：精确匹配，匹配条件中的Community必须与被匹配路由的Community一致，才判定为匹配成功

CommunityOperateMode.description_en:
The action to perform on the Community attribute. Valid values:

Additive: adds the Community attribute to the route.

Replace: replaces the existing Community attribute of the route.

This parameter specifies the action to perform after a route matches the match conditions
CommunityOperateMode.description_zh:
Community的执行模式。

Additive：添加，表示为路由添加Community。

Replace：替换，表示替换路由原有的Community。

本参数表示路由通过匹配条件后，要执行的操作

Description.description_en: The description of the route map

DestinationChildInstanceType.description_en:
The list of destination instance types that the route must match. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.

VBR: virtual border router (VBR) instance.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance.

VPN: IPsec connection.

The destination instance type list takes effect only when the route map is applied in the outbound direction from the regional gateway and the destination instance types belong to the local region
DestinationChildInstanceType.description_zh:
路由需匹配的目的实例类型列表。

VPC：专有网络实例。

VBR：边界路由器实例。

CCN：云连接网实例。

VPN：IPsec连接。

仅路由策略的应用方向为出地域网关方向，且目的实例类型为本地域下的实例类型时，目的实例类型列表才会生效

DestinationInstanceIdsReverseMatch.description_en:
Indicates whether the reverse match mode is used for the destination instance ID list.

false: The reverse match mode is not used. A route matches the condition if the destination instance ID of the route is in DestinationInstanceIds.N.

true: The reverse match mode is used. A route matches the condition if the destination instance ID of the route is not in DestinationInstanceIds.N

true：是，即路由传递的目的实例ID不在DestinationInstanceIds.N中时，匹配通过

DestinationRouteTableId.description_en:
The list of destination route table IDs that the route must match. A maximum of 32 route table IDs are supported.

The destination route table ID list takes effect only when the route map is applied in the outbound direction from the regional gateway and the destination route table IDs belong to network instances in the local region

仅路由策略的应用方向为出地域网关方向，且目的路由表ID为本地域下网络实例的路由表ID时，目的路由表ID列表才会生效

MapResult.description_en:
The action to perform on a route that matches all match conditions. Valid values:

Permit: allows the matched route to pass.

Deny: rejects the matched route
MapResult.description_zh:
所有匹配条件都通过后的策略行为。

Permit：允许被匹配的路由通过。

Deny：拒绝被匹配的路由通过

MatchAddressType.description_en:
The IP address type that the route must match. Valid values:

IPv4: matches only IPv4 routes.
IPv6: matches only IPv6 routes.
If this value is not returned, both IPv4 and IPv6 routes are matched
MatchAddressType.description_zh:

IPv4：表示只匹配IPv4路由。
IPv6：表示只匹配IPv6路由。
如果系统未返回该值，则表示同时匹配IPv4和IPv6的路由
